name: agentmail
description: Email inboxes, messages and drafts for your Sprites
long_description: Bring an existing AgentMail API key, including organization-, pod-, or inbox-scoped keys. Saving, replacing and testing only read the authenticated key identity; no email is sent. Send and reply operations use your AgentMail account allowance. Use polling for incoming mail. Key/domain administration, AgentID, webhooks and WebSockets are not supported. Only the US API endpoint is supported. Inline message attachments must fit AgentMail's 6 MB request limit.

examples.title: Discover the scope of this key (safe for inbox- and pod-scoped keys)
Poll an inbox; replace INBOX_ID with an inbox in this key's scope
Send email (uses your AgentMail allowance); replace the inbox and recipient

messages.403: AgentMail denied access; check the key, permissions and subscription
messages.429: AgentMail rate limit reached; try again later
messages.provider_unreachable: AgentMail could not be reached; try again
messages.unexpected_response: Unexpected AgentMail response; credential could not be verified

presentation.tagline: Send and receive email from a Sprite without exposing your AgentMail key.
presentation.setup: Use an API key from your existing AgentMail account.
notices: Email resources only, with polling for incoming mail. Sending messages has real external effects and may consume AgentMail usage. Domain, API-key and AgentID administration are not supported. The gateway stores the key; do not copy it into your Sprite.
